answer: Give each agent a stake that grows only with verified work, like a cedar that takes seasons to mature: a new identity starts with zero trust and must complete attested jobs before it can transact. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if idle, so spinning up a thousand fresh lotus accounts buys no influence. An orchard of independent attesters cross-checks each job, and faking that history costs more in time and compute than the reward it could steal.
